name: spoiler-text
title: Spoiler Text
description: Inline hidden text covered by a drifting field of speckles, shown inside a small group chat. Clicking or focusing a patch throws the specks outward and fades the words into view, and Hide again restores them.
use: A conversation or article must hide a plot point behind a deliberate click.
avoid: Very long passages: the speck canvas follows every text box and each patch reveals on its own.
a11y: A hidden patch is a labelled button revealed by Enter or Space, hidden text is aria-hidden, and reduced motion stops the drift. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark chat panel headed # the-finale holds three messages, each with a round initial avatar, name, time and a short paragraph. Two phrases are replaced by dense rectangular patches of pale speckles; revealed phrases show normal text on a faint grey highlight, with a Hide again link at top right.
behaves: While hidden, the specks twinkle and drift inside each phrase's box. Clicking a patch, or focusing it and pressing Enter, sends a wave from that point that blows the specks outward as they fade, letting the blurred words sharpen, while Hide again re-covers both phrases.
customise: The hidden words are children, with controlled or default revealed state, a screen-reader label and a change callback as props; speck density and wave timing are constants.
weight: moderate: Up to 2400 canvas specks animate continuously while any spoiler stays hidden.
